import numpy as np
def equation(t, A, params):
    p = params
    A2 = A**2
    L = np.log(t)
    F = p[0] + p[1]/t + p[2]/t**2 + p[3]*L + p[4]*t + p[5]*t**2
    G = p[6] + p[7]*L + p[8]*t + p[9]/t
    return F + G*A2
